resources.string: Choose maps on a map, review package details, and manage offline storage.
Tap a region to select it. Drag to move and pinch to zoom.
The region map could not be loaded. Use the region selector below.
Unknown regions are outlined until checked. Blue reflects the last successful check; availability can change. Administrative boundaries are for selection, not routing.
Select a region on the map or in the List tab.
Current package details are unavailable. You may be offline, or this release may be unavailable. Installed maps remain usable.
Package availability has not been checked.
Delete all %2$d downloaded version(s) of %1$s? This package will no longer be available offline. If active, its lookup will stop. Other packages and the bundled starter map are kept.
Delete all downloaded maps and all their versions? Only the bundled starter map will remain. Other app data is kept.
Closing this screen does not cancel the download.
Region map. Use the List tab for a searchable, accessible list, including small and overseas regions.
Installed coverage comes from the whole-country package: %1$s. Deleting it affects all regions covered by that package.
Installed map status is unavailable. Deletion is disabled until the inventory can be read.
Installed packages changed. Review the deletion scope again.
The server reports no package for this region (404/410). Installed data is retained. Refresh details to check again.
Failed downloads: %1$d. See each region in List.
